content:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney had a little fun at President Donald Trump’s expense over the weekend at a press dinner that included two different political impersonators.

“Damn. This is a tough room,” Carney cracked. “And I’ve been in the Oval Office, alone, with its new interior decorator.”

Trump has been giving the White House a makeover with golden decor, reportedly gluing some of the Oval Office embellishments in place himself.

Carney’s joke came at Saturday’s Parliamentary Press Gallery dinner, which traditionally features political figures poking fun at themselves and one another.

Carney hit what he called the “emergency comedy button,” summoning a Carney impersonator (Mark McKinney of “The Kids in the Hall”), who was soon interrupted by a Trump impersonator (Mark Critch of “This Hour Has 22 Minutes”).

“We’ve got two Carneys here. It’s a disaster,” the mock Trump said. “He’s so popular. Almost as popular as me. It’s like ‘Heated Rivalry’ if the hockey players were straight and all goalies.”

The fake Trump borrowed a line from the real one as he complimented Carney.

“He’s got a great ass, doesn’t he? What a beautiful ass,” fake Trump said. “He’s got such an incredible ass.”

Trump has also frequently mocked Carney by calling him the “governor” of the 51st U.S. state, but the mock Trump said he wouldn’t use the title in person.

“I call him Mark,” he said. “I don’t call him ‘the governor’ to his face because I’m a coward.”

He said he’d like to make a deal to end the trade war between the United States and Canada.

“There’s only one thing standing in the way,” the mock Trump said. “Me, ’cause I’m crazy.”
